title: China 2027 Travel Planner — Beijing & Shanghai
subtitle: Official-source Calendar, MICHELIN Dining, Activities & Transit; Third-Party Hotel Rate Snapshots and Itineraries for Two Adults
scope_note: Self-contained, source-labeled dual-city planner published under china-2027/ alongside sibling single-city and social-audit directories. Calendar, MICHELIN, activity, and transit research was checked 2026-11-26; third-party Booking.com hotel rate snapshots were refreshed 2026-11-27 and are scoped to exact dates and rate plans.

trip_brief.travel_window: 2027-02-15 to 2027-03-23 (36-night date span; 37 calendar dates including both endpoints)
trip_brief.preferred_start: 2027-02-15 to 2027-02-18 (flagged: 3 nights as a literal window vs 1-2 week / 2-4 week trip options)
trip_brief.hotel_requirements: Private/attached bathroom; queen bed or larger (king); shortlist ranked by stated location, amenities, and MICHELIN access. Hotel prices are seven-night Booking.com totals for 2 adults/1 room on exact sampled dates, with taxes/fees included where the listing says so; they are dynamic third-party offers, not guarantees. Refundability, member eligibility, payment terms, and breakfast vary by offer; no universal cheapest stay date is claimed.
cities_covered: Beijing (33/33 MICHELIN 2027 starred directly verified + 8 Bib Gourmand/Selected + 10 gov-verified activities + 8 hotel candidates; four core hotels have repeat rate captures, four are Feb 15–22 only)

Shanghai (live MICHELIN guide counts 1x3*, 11x2*, 38x1* = 50 starred + 15 directly verified restaurants + 6 gov/operator-verified activities + 5 hotel candidates; three core hotels have repeat captures, two are Feb 15–22 only)

calendar_2027.source_title: State Council General Office — 2027 Public Holiday Schedule (published 2026-11-06)
calendar_2027.lantern_festival: 2027-02-20 (Sat) — 15th day of Lunar Month 1; event/lantern schedules in Beijing and Shanghai Yuyuan are not verified here and need current official confirmation; not a statutory bank holiday
calendar_2027.key_implication: Zero PRC statutory holidays fall inside 2027-02-15 to 2027-03-23. Starting Feb 15 or Feb 18 places the Beijing stay after the Spring Festival break and can include Lantern Festival (Feb 20). The sampled hotel rates are date- and rate-plan-specific; they do not establish a universal cheapest stay date or a guaranteed saving.
calendar_risks: Potential post-Spring-Festival demand (Feb 14–21): rail availability and ticket-release rules are date/train-specific. Confirm the 2027 release window on 12306 and book promptly once tickets for the chosen train are available; no specific seat availability is guaranteed.

Potential early-March NPC/CPPCC ("Two Sessions") security restrictions: 2027 meeting dates and any specific Tian’anmen/Chang’an Avenue closures are not verified here. Check current official notices before scheduling central-axis visits; this is not evidence that a different hotel date is cheaper.
calendar_2027.weekday_discrepancy: Feb 5, 2027 is Friday according to the Hong Kong Observatory calendar; an Official Gazette copy labels it Sunday. The State Council notice supplies the holiday date range; this weekday discrepancy is preserved in the audit and Friday is used.

hsr_beijing_shanghai.route: Beijing South Railway Station <-> Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station (~1,300 km)
hsr_beijing_shanghai.duration: Fastest Fuxing G-trains ~4.5-5.5 hr; standard G-trains 5-6 hr

beijing_subway.fares: Distance-based: CNY 3 (<=6 km), CNY 4 (6-12 km), CNY 5 (12-22 km), CNY 6 (22-32 km), +CNY 1 per 20 km beyond 32 km. Capital Airport Express: flat CNY 25.
beijing_subway.network_update: Subway Line 17 central section (Workers' Stadium-Shilihe), Line 18, and Line 6 southern extension opened 2025-12-27, strengthening direct north-south rail links across Chaoyang CBD and Sanlitun.

shanghai_metro.fares: Distance-based (2005 schedule): CNY 3 (<=6 km), +CNY 1 per 10 km. Passes: 1-Day CNY 18, 3-Day CNY 45, Maglev+1-Day Metro CNY 55 (1-way) / CNY 85 (round-trip). Airport Link Line (Hongqiao<->Pudong ~40 min): CNY 4-26. Tap-to-Ride supports international Visa/Mastercard/Amex/JCB contactless cards at gates.
shanghai_metro.fare_review_flag: FLAGGED: On 2026-08-20 Shanghai published two fare-adjustment proposals (~+CNY 1/trip average) ahead of a 2026-09-07 public hearing. Re-verify final 2027 fare table before departure.
